original.scope: Regression on the now-exposed 32 planner and 8 conversation cases. Router fitting uses the separately committed split, without conversation case labels or references. This is development integration, not a fresh assistant-quality test, admitted cohort or graph promotion.

review.scope: Exposed development regression; no training or admission; every draft reviewed.

scoped.scope: Exposed development regression: original eight conversations plus one retained structured-data input. Learned selection is restricted by committed input subjects and record schemas; answers remain actual greedy model output. No new training, quality admission, or independent quality claim. The failed plan-review policy is excluded.

resources.scope: Conservative allocated compute estimate; storage and data transfer separate.

decision: No quality promotion. Scope checks recover ordinary science answers, but the frozen planner loses references and splits a structured request. Review worsened 28/32 drafts to 1/32. Do not adopt the review method. No top-level milestone completed.
